Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. **Component** — the S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`), defined in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`. Its `CheckAndPresign` method re-generates presigned S3 URLs for attachments whose external (S3) object references would otherwise expire — it re-presigns any whose last presigned time is within 4 days of the 5-day expiration (`runner.go:85-91`).

**Schedule** — every 12 hours, via a `time.Ticker` (`const runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`; ticker loop at `runner.go:29-41`). It also runs once immediately at startup (`RunOnce`).

**Wiring site** — `server/server.go:162-171`, inside `startBackgroundRunners`. The runner is created and run once at `server/server.go:162-163`, then its continuous 12-hour loop is launched in a background goroutine at `server/server.go:169`.

Answer: `s3presign.Runner` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go) — every 12 hours (plus one run at startup) — server/server.go:162 (goroutine loop launched at server/server.go:169)
